notes:
Summary: Mid-size national retail chain evaluating real-time agent assist to reduce AHT and improve handle quality during holiday spikes. Focus: streaming suggestions into agent desktop (Zendesk), low-latency SLOs (p95 < 150ms for suggestion arrival), safe tool-calling for order lookups and refunds, and robust fallbacks during capacity spikes.

Key quotes: "If suggestions are slow or wrong, agents will ignore them — latency + precision both critical." — Sr. Ops Director.

Security / compliance: must keep customer PII in-region, need KMS + audit trail for each LLM call, retention policy 30d for transcripts, redaction of payment data. SOC2 evidence requested; legal wants vendor DPA reviewed.

Technical constraints: Zendesk app hooks for streaming, existing CTI uses Avaya (legacy), single-tenant VPC preferred, periodic 10x traffic spikes during promotions. They prefer canary rollouts and auto-fallback to a quantized smaller model for cost containment.

Commercial: leaning toward Dedicated for predictable latency; potentially Private for select regions. Budget range discussed but procurement wants firm SLA language.

CRM shorthand: POC started 2026-02-20; load test scheduled 2026-03-08; security questionnaire under review (SEC-1290). Maya driving technical; Jordan owns deal. Next: deliver streaming SLO config + playbook (action: Jordan send doc).
